notes.title: Fault Zero One & Single Lane MP
notes.content:
[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/dlc5_news_194423.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the age of the hyper-advanced Megalopolis – where man and machine are only distinguishable by their medical records.

Fault One Zero, the 5th DLC pack for Trials Fusion, includes of a whole new career event which will see players gliding through holographic cityscapes, testing facilities, and even worlds of retro gaming. You will have new achievements & trophies, editor pieces, a new Dark Lynx helmet and a brand new look for everyone’s go to bike, the Pit Viper.

There might even be an Epic Boss Battle hidden in the mix.

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/trials/portal/DLC5-screen01_194437.jpg[/img]

What else is in the package?
[*]Epic tracks, featuring:
[list][*]8 Classic Trials Tracks
[*]1 Skill Game 
[*]1 FMX Track[/list]
[*]2 new garage items
[list][*]“DarkLynx” helmet 
[*]New look for the Pit Viper[/list]
[*]Five new achievements/trophies
[list][*]250 Gamer Score on Xbox One
[*]100 Gamer Score on Xbox 360
[*]1 Gold, 2 Silver and 2 Bronze Trophies on PlayStation 4[/list]
[*]24 new Track Challenges
[list][*]Each Classic Trials track features three surprising Track Challenges
[*]Track Challenges ranging from warping to a magic-rainbow-land to defeating a giant robot.[/list]
[*]Dozens of new Editor Objects, including:
[list][*]Giant advanced robotics
[*]Colourful holographic ramps
[*]Portals and warps[/list]

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/trials/portal/DLC5-robot-concept_194438.jpg[/img]

In addition to Fault One Zero, our latest patch includes the following notable updates for Trials Fusion;

[*]21 reworked & new Track Central Feeds
[list][*]Recently Played
[*]Newest for XSX, SX, FMX and Skill Games
[*]Feeds for Highest Rated 24hr & Month[/list]
[*]Single Player Career Trials Tracks in Private Online Multiplayer
[list][*]Over 50 track additions for Online MP
[*]Includes Trials Fusion Standard Edition and DLC tracks[/list]

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/trials/portal/DU1-Screen2_193778.jpg[/img]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/337740/?snr=1_7_7_151_150_1]Fault One Zero is available for $4.99[/url] for the DLC, or included in the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/287330/]$19.99 Season Pass[/url], which includes our 4 previous DLC packs, as well as 1 more to come before May 2015. Both the DLC and Season Pass are available on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/245490/]Trials Fusion Steam Store Page[/url].

notes.title: Online Multiplayer & Fire In The Deep DLC Now Available
notes.content:
The next big update for Trials Fusion is here, and with it comes the addition of the single highest requested feature since Trials Fusion’s launch; Online Multiplayer. As well as talking about this awesome new feature, we’ll get into the change log and talk a little about what is coming up next in the game.

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/dlc4_news_192151.jpg[/img]

Trials Online Multiplayer has been a staple for many fans since its introduction in Trials Evolution and our team has been working insanely hard to create this new MP from the ground up in ways that do what they can to increase what you can do with Trials. Not only have we doubled the amount of playable lanes on PC and current-gen systems, but you now have the ability to host and spectate races, tournaments, or even seasons (if you have the patience to deal with all of the data entry). 

Spectating isn’t all! Each player’s character will now appear on the closest lane. This is fairly huge in Trials where seeing where small moments of having your view obstructed can be the difference between absolute victory and taking a loss on your card.

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/trials/portal/DLC4-Screenshot_192149.jpg[/img]

Custom races? Oh yeah, we’ve got some tools to help create some insane custom matches. Alter gravity, speed, weight, set everyone on fire and more to help you create some crazy fun matches that rival the insanity of working next to ANBA. You like challenges? We’re sure you’ll soon find community tracks that can try the patience of you and up to 7 of your friends on Track Central.

The tools for creating amazing Online MP tracks will soon be available in the Editor, allowing for unlimited amounts of tracks to be created by the talented Trials community. Create, share and play your favorite Online MP tracks, and just like single player tracks, the studio favorites will find their way into Uplay Recommended for all players to enjoy.

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/trials/portal/DLC4-DrillCrane_192148.jpg[/img]

Fire in the Deep! Amidst the infernal heat hidden deep below the Earth's surface, they excavate in secret; burrowing deeper underground through bubbling lava, seedy avenues and titanic rock-crushing machinery.

What secrets are hidden in the sweltering depths of the Earth? Some answers will need to be searched out on your own.

Introducing the largest content pack to date for Trials Fusion. Fire in the Deep adds a whole new career event, new tracks, editor pieces and far more!
[list]
[*]Nine Classic Trials Tracks
[list]
[*]10 hidden audio logs to find
[*]27 new Track Challenges
[list]
[*]Track Challenges range from secret locations to surprising mini-games, such as:
[list]
[*]Hunters of Secrets
[*]Missile Commander
[*]Super Meat Trials
[/list][/list][/list]
[*]One new Skill Game "Circles of Hell"
[*]One new FMX Track, "Manic Miner"
[*]2 new garage items
[list]
[*]“Billy Gruff” helmet 
[*]New look for the TKO-Panda
[/list]
[*]Dozens of new Editor Objects, including:
[list]
[*]Mammoth heavy-duty machinery
[*]Dynamic lava
[*]Genuinely epic train set[/list][/list]

Trials Fusion Online MP is included in a free update for Trials Fusion, and Fire in the Deep is available for $4.99 for the DLC, or included in the $19.99 Season Pass, which includes our 3 previous DLC packs, as well as 2 more to come before March 2015. Both the DLC and Season Pass are available on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/245490/]Trials Fusion Steam Store Page.[/url]

notes.title: Trials Fusion DLC #3 Released - Welcome to the Abyss
notes.content:
Welcome to the Abyss! The third DLC for Trials Fusion launches today for PC and all consoles. Welcome to the Abyss is available for all Season Pass holders for free and can be downloaded via in-game or the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/326170/]DLC Steam Store page[/url]. For those that do not own a Season Pass, you can of course still purchase it for $19.99 from the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/287330]Season Pass Steam Store page[/url] and will receive Welcome to the Abyss along with the previous DLC's and future DLC's. If you just want Welcome To The Abyss, it is available now for $4.99 in the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/326170/]DLC Steam Store page[/url]. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4ELuL0g.png1[/img]

[h1]This DLC contains the most Trials Tracks in a DLC yet:[/h1]
[list]
[*]8 classic Trials tracks
[*]Featuring 24 Challenges
[*]1 Skill Game
[*]1 FMX Track
[*]100+ New Editor Items
[*]Including 12 New Effects
[*]3 New squirrels to discover
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FURuNzZ.jpg?1[/img]

[h1]Welcome To The Abyss[/h1]
Leave the utopia of Empire of the Sky and delve deep into some serious exploration of the mysterious ruins under the sea. Pristine stone relics flow with energy from an unknown power source, enabling ancient machinery to continue operating. This wonder, combined with the proof of worship of an unidentified deity bring up questions for fearless riders to explore. Riders should proceed with caution though; there is more to these ancient ruins than what first meets the eye.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/zATzZvr.jpg?1[/img]

We are really excited about this DLC and we hope you enjoy exploring the Abyss! Visit our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/245490/discussions/0/616189743039394406/]DLC thread[/url] to drop your feedback!

notes.title: Trials Fusion DLC #2 Released - Empire of the Sky
notes.content:
Empire of the Sky, the next DLC for Trials Fusion is now available on the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/245490]Steam Store[/url], and will be available globally as a digital download for $4.99 (free for Season Pass holders) on the Xbox One, Xbox 360, PS4, and PC. This DLC is the second installment of six DLCs that will be coming in Trials Fusion’s first season.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uG8lock.jpg[/img]

This DLC will be free for Season Pass holders who will be receiving five additional packs that will be released through May 2015 (inlcuding Riders of the Rustlands). You are still able to purchase the Season Pass for Trials Fusion from the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/245490]Steam Store Page[/url] or you can pick up the DLC by heading directly to the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/311551/]Empire of the Sky DLC page[/url].

[img]http://i.imgur.com/PAO4pSO.jpg[/img]

Let’s dive right into it and take a look at what you are getting:

Nine exciting new tracks, including:
[list]
[*]Six Classic Trials Tracks
[*]One new Supercross (local multiplayer) track
[*]One new Skill Game "Freefall"
[*]One new FMX Track, "High Society"
[/list]

Eighteen new Track Challenges
[list]
[*]Each Classic Trials Track features three surprising Track Challenges
[*]Track Challenges range from secret locations to surprising mini-games, such as:
[*]Crash the dinner party
[*]Skydive with the Penguins!
[*]Please the Paparazzi!
[/list]

Dozens of new Editor Objects, including:
[list]
[*]Anti-gravity technology
[*]Resort homes
[*]Force fields
[*]Floating platforms
[/list]

There are four more DLC packs planned for Trials Fusion’s first season. Stay tuned to keep up to date on all things Trials Fusion; you never know when we’ll have more info to drop.

notes.title: Trials Fusion DLC #1 Released - Riders of the Rustlands
notes.content:
Rev up your engines, Riders of the Rustlands is available right now on Steam & all console platforms! Head to the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/245490]Store Page[/url] or visit the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/311550/]Riders Of The Rustlands[/url] page to pick up this new DLC.

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-GB/game/trials/portal/news_DLC1_160876.png[/img]

[h1]Riders of the Rustlands[/h1]

It’s time to continue your journey of racing dominance on the leader boards by venturing out into the fringes of civilization, leaving the cityscapes and high-tech regions in your dust. In the Rustlands, you will encounter the home of people who have been ignored and forgotten by their government, people forced to scavenge through the shambles of once-thriving facilities in an effort to survive outside of the gleaming high-rises and vast cities. Warring factions, neglected laboratories and tetanus boosters are a way of life in the Rustlands.

[url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-IJdQC_y5G0][img]http://i.imgur.com/0dmSt0G.png[/img][/url]
[h1]What You Will Receive[/h1]

Riders of the Rustlands brings ten new tracks to Trials Fusion, adding six medium-and-up difficulty classic Trials Tracks, two Supercross Tracks, one Skill Game, and one FMX Track. There are also 18 Track Challenges, with new secret locations, and additional squirrels to be discovered, as well as 5 new achievements to earn. Track creators will find a nice selection of new Rustlands pieces in the Track Editor to use in their custom content. You can pick up the Riders of the Rustlands now on your platform of choice, or purchase the Season Pass and secure all six downloadable content packs that will be available over the next year at a savings of over 30%.

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-GB/game/trials/portal/rags4_160877.jpg[/img]

[h1]Future Content[/h1]

With over one million players, Trials Fusion continues to gain traction as riders strive for perfection and leader board position on each course. The team at RedLynx Studios has no plan to slow down; five more downloadable content packs are being created including Empire of the Sky, the next piece of DLC set in floating islands, as well as free Feature Pack updates coming throughout the year that introduce exciting new features to the game.

Discuss this new Trials Fusion DLC [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/245490/discussions/0/35219681472326852/]here[/url]. For the latest on Trials Fusion, visit Trials [url=trialsgame.com]on the web[/url], follow [url=http://www.twitter.com/trialsgames]@TrialsGames[/url] on Twitter, [url=https://www.facebook.com/trials.official]Trials Official[/url] on Facebook, and catch the official live streams on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/redlynxofficial]Twitch[/url].

[url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-IJdQC_y5G0][img]http://i.imgur.com/0dmSt0G.png[/img][/url]
[h1]What You Will Receive[/h1]

Riders of the Rustlands brings ten new tracks to Trials Fusion, adding six medium-and-up difficulty classic Trials Tracks, two Supercross Tracks, one Skill Game, and one FMX Track. There are also 18 Track Challenges, with new secret locations, and additional squirrels to be discovered, as well as 5 new achievements to earn. Track creators will find a nice selection of new Rustlands pieces in the Track Editor to use in their custom content. You can pick up the Riders of the Rustlands now on your platform of choice, or purchase the Season Pass and secure all six downloadable content packs that will be available over the next year at a savings of over 30%.

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-GB/game/trials/portal/rags4_160877.jpg[/img]

[h1]Future Content[/h1]

With over one million players, Trials Fusion continues to gain traction as riders strive for perfection and leader board position on each course. The team at RedLynx Studios has no plan to slow down; five more downloadable content packs are being created including Empire of the Sky, the next piece of DLC set in floating islands, as well as free Feature Pack updates coming throughout the year that introduce exciting new features to the game.

Discuss this new Trials Fusion DLC [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/245490/discussions/0/35219681472326852/]here[/url]. For the latest on Trials Fusion, visit Trials [url=trialsgame.com]on the web[/url], follow [url=http://www.twitter.com/trialsgames]@TrialsGames[/url] on Twitter, [url=https://www.facebook.com/trials.official]Trials Official[/url] on Facebook, and catch the official live streams on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/redlynxofficial]Twitch[/url].

notes.title: Trials Fusion Update #3: Custom Supercross
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/BtE8EF_CcAA9jd5.png[/img]

Greetings Trials riders, 

Our first DLC [b]Riders of the Rustlands[/b] releases July 29th, but even before the first of 6 DLCs release next week, we’re going to have some new stuff coming to Trials Fusion in a new update. Not only will this update be filled with fixes and improvements for Tournaments, Track Central, the Track Editor and more but we are also adding a much requested feature. Track builders will now have the option to create custom Supercross tracks for the Local Multiplayer mode. Throw down 4 lanes of motorcross madness in the editor then invite your friends over and challenge them on your devious creations. The update is available today (Thursday, July 24th).

"What else does it have?" you ask, check out the full patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/245490/discussions/0/38596747824903752/]HERE[/url].

notes.title: Tournament Feature Pack & June 18th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/245490/discussions/0/540744934270260801/][img]http://drh1.img.digitalriver.com/DRHM/Storefront/Company/ubi/images/hero/TRFU_hero2.jpg[/img][/url]

Hello Riders! 

It's time for our first Feature Pack which includes a newly designed feature in Trials Fusion! Some of you have guessed at it being the return of Tournaments, and while that is correct, there have been quite a few changes to how this feature works.

This free update comes with some minor and major changes that all of you have been requesting. We are definitely listening! We also want to be clear that we are still working on tons of more features, more fixes, and more updates. 

Track Central is going to be a big focus for us and we want to assure you that we are dedicated to providing excellent support to the awesomely creative fans out there. 

You can read and discuss all of the changes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/245490/discussions/0/540744934270260801/]HERE[/url].
